title: On Watching the boats until the light failed
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：watch　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 watch 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the keeper ① watched the boats until the light failed at once, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② watches the boats until the light failed in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ watch the boats until the light failed at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ watched the boats until the light failed before — a line in the calendar for January 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Watching the boats until the light failed at once, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ watch for the first sign of rain in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Watch for the first sign of rain at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ watches for the first sign of rain at once every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ watched the boats until the light failed again when nobody else would.

⑩ To watch the boats until the light failed, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody watches the boats until the light failed in the rain again and somebody must watch the boats until the light failed at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 注视（一般过去式 watched the boats until the light failed：1957 年守夜人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 注视（一般现在 watches the boats until the light failed：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 注视（不定式 to watch the boats until the light failed：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 注视（过去完成时 had watched the boats until the light failed：1951 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 注视（动名词 watching the boats until the light failed 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 留意（watch for the first sign of rain：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去留意留意下雨的头一个征兆）
G. v. 留意（watch for the first sign of rain：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 注视（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 watches for the first sign of rain，而母亲又一次 watched the boats until the light failed）

answers.why: watch 意为“注视”，1957 年守夜人二话不说地注视盯着那些船直到天黑，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 watched。
watch 意为“注视”，自那以后守夜人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 watches。
watch 意为“注视”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯注视盯着那些船直到天黑”，此处为不定式 to watch the boats until the light failed。
watch 意为“注视”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人注视过，故用过去完成时 had watched。
watch 意为“注视”，守夜人说“注视盯着那些船直到天黑这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 watching the boats until the light failed 作主语。
watch 意为“留意”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去留意留意下雨的头一个征兆”，should ever 之后用原形 watch for the first sign of rain。
watch 意为“留意”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻留意留意下雨的头一个征兆（watch for the first sign of rain at once），以后再也不要提起。
watch 意为“注视”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例留意留意下雨的头一个征兆，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 watches。
watch 意为“注视”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地注视盯着那些船直到天黑，用一般过去式 watched 叙述。
watch 意为“注视”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要注视盯着那些船直到天黑，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 watch 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the keeper watched the boats until the light failed at once, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper watches the boats until the light failed in the rain whenever the tower asks.
Watching the boats until the light failed at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever watch for the first sign of rain in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower watches for the first sign of rain at once every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother watched the boats until the light failed again, and the tower remembered that half.
